g.text: A network run by one operator to provide mobile services to the public
Made of radio access, core network and connections to other networks
Asks home PLMN to verify you
Main blocks of one operator network
Links to PSTN and the Internet
How a PLMN is named and found
Mobile Country Code, 3 digits. India uses 404 and 405
Mobile Network Code, 2–3 digits, one per operator
Location or Tracking Area Code, groups cells for paging
Identifies a single cell inside the area
IMSI = MCC + MNC + MSIN (up to 15 digits)
The first five or six digits tell which PLMN owns the SIM
Used by visited networks to find the home PLMN
It scans and finds the visited PLMN
Visited network reads the IMSI and contacts the home PLMN
HLR checks the SIM and returns authentication data
Visitor profile copied to the visited VLR
Visited network sends usage back to the home operator
